preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and isinstance(k, int) and 2 <= k <= n and k % 2 == 0 for n, k in test_cases_params)
preconditions.description: For each test case, n and k are integers where 2 <= k <= n and k is even.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(s, str) and len(s) == n and all(c in '01?' for c in s) for n, s in test_cases_strings)
preconditions.description: For each test case, s is a string of length n containing only characters '0', '1', and '?'.
The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 3*10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(line in ['YES', 'NO'] for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((possible_k_balanced(n, k, s) and line == 'YES') or (not possible_k_balanced(n, k, s) and line == 'NO') for (n, k, s), line in zip(test_cases_full, stdout_lines))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 'YES' if and only if there exists a way to replace all '?' in s with '0' or '1' such that every substring of length k in the resulting string has exactly k/2 zeros and k/2 ones; otherwise, the output is 'NO'.
